__note: This is the seed schema for a fresh Jarvis install. Fields are populated as you use Jarvis: 'user' (name + preferences + rules captured via /memory and /rules), 'projects' (per-project context detected via tools/project_scanner.py), 'history' (rolling conversation tail used to give Claude context), 'last_session' (ISO timestamp of the last interaction). The 'rules' array stores global rules; per-project rules live in .jarvisrules files at each project root. Safe to commit this stub. Do NOT commit a populated memory.json — add it to .gitignore if you want to keep personal data fully local.
